interval_method: Bonferroni-expanded marginal percentile bootstrap; approximate nominal family coverage, not exact finite-sample coverage
primary_family: all eight models x two datasets x two sensors at frozen main interface; primary cohort only
requested_only_eligibility: A0 correct AND same target-question/sensor requested-only correct AND frozen second-congruent exists
sensitivity_intervals: pointwise 95%, posthoc, not multiplicity-adjusted; all positions retained
invalid_policy: NaN retained and counted; no redraw
source_audit_scope: local permitted metadata only; no protected contents or network access
